clue.text: Used to endorse promise of marriage

parts.note: to second a motion is to back or endorse it
to give one's hand is to promise oneself in marriage

explanation.surface: Someone supporting a proposal of marriage, as if seconding a motion.
explanation.definitionFit: Something used has already had an owner before, so it is not new but second-owner goods.

clue.text: Statistical technique for calculating mass absorbed by a young tree

indicators.note: absorbed by means the letter for mass is taken inside the young tree

parts.note: a sapling is a young tree
M is the abbreviation for mass in physics

explanation.surface: A method for working out the weight a young tree takes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Sampling is a statistical method of studying a subset to estimate the whole.

clue.text: Prisoner putting up pictures on the other side

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner

indicators.note: in a down clue putting up means reading the word upwards

parts.note: art is pictures collectively

explanation.surface: A convict hangs pictures on the opposite wall of his cell.
explanation.definitionFit: Contra is Latin for against, so it means on the opposing side.

clue.text: Restricted by new pointer

parts.note: an arrow points the way

explanation.surface: Being limited by a fresh signpost.
explanation.definitionFit: Narrow means limited or restricted in scope.

clue.text: Bag needed by journalist covering raves, perhaps?

indicators.note: covering means the journalist wraps round the other letters

parts.note: a hack is a journalist, often a low-grade one

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters of raves may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A reporter sent to cover raves needs a bag for the job.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's journalist covering raves reads as reporting on parties; in the wordplay 'covering' means wrapping round, and 'perhaps' marks the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A haversack is a bag carried on the back or shoulder.

clue.text: Many ride out with such farmworkers

indicators.note: out signals the letters of many ride are put out of order

explanation.surface: Many ride out with farmhands of this kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Dairymen are farm workers who tend milk cattle.

clue.text: Lunatic shot back

indicators.note: back tells us to read the word for shot from right to left

parts.note: a shot is an attempt, a stab

explanation.surface: A madman fires back at someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns STAB round to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To be described as bats is slang for being crazy, as in having bats in the belfry.

clue.text: Decorative wear for girl supporting group

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting means sitting underneath, so the girl's name goes below the group

parts.note: a band is a musical group
Anna is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl backing up a pop group wears something colourful.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandanna is a coloured kerchief worn on the head or neck as an ornament.

clue.text: To sum up, deal to seal it

indicators.note: deal as in dealing cards, which are shuffled out, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Concluding that the agreement should seal the matter.
explanation.definitionFit: To totalise is to add up or combine into a total.

clue.text: Tree worker needing trees

parts.note: man as a verb or noun for a hand or worker
a grove is a small group of trees

explanation.surface: A forester who needs a wood to work in.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical species of tree growing in coastal swamps with tangled roots.

clue.text: Singular origin of neglect in French house fire

parts.note: S or I; here I for one, a single thing

indicators.note: in places the letter from neglect inside the French holiday home

parts.note: a gîte is a French country cottage

indicators.note: the origin of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A rural French cottage goes up in flames through someone's carelessness.
explanation.definitionFit: To fire something is to set it alight, a verb synonym for kindling.

clue.text: Left king to grab a table for port

indicators.note: to grab means the letters for left and king clutch the a between them

parts.note: R, from Latin rex, is the abbreviation for king
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A departing monarch seizes a table to take to a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Larboard is the old nautical name for the port side of a ship.

clue.text: How often do you see a lord embraced by two unknowns?

indicators.note: embraced by means the nobleman sits inside the pair of unknowns

parts.note: in algebra x, y and z are unknowns; two of them here are Y and Y
an earl is a lord

explanation.surface: A question about how frequently one meets a peer flanked by two strangers.
explanation.definitionFit: Yearly answers the question of frequency: once every twelve months.

clue.text: What might be left when the wheels come off?

definitions.text: What might be left when the wheels come off?

parts.words: What might be left when the wheels come off?
parts.note: read as a car breaking down, but literally the rod on which wheels turn remains once they are removed

explanation.surface: A car falls apart and you wonder what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: The shaft that wheels are mounted on is still there when the wheels are taken away.

clue.text: One who looks for understanding

parts.note: seems to describe a seeker of knowledge, but literally someone who watches mouths moving to follow speech

explanation.surface: A person seeking enlightenment.
explanation.definitionFit: A deaf person who watches speakers' mouths looks in order to understand.

clue.text: Concierge about to drop the first two of a kind

indicators.note: about signals that the remaining letters are rearranged
the first two letters of concierge are removed

explanation.surface: A hotel porter turning round to drop off two guests.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing CO from CONCIERGE leaves NCIERGE, which 'about' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Generic means relating to a whole class or kind, rather than a specific brand.

clue.text: Final thing that happens — you'll be reported

parts.note: an event is something that happens

indicators.note: be reported signals a word said aloud

parts.note: spoken quickly, you'll gives the closing syllables

explanation.surface: Something final will happen, so you'll be told.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventual means coming at the end, ultimate.

clue.text: Skilled performer in open next to fail

indicators.note: fail suggests the words break down, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An expert in an open contest beside someone about to flop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fail' rearranges OPEN NEXT; 'in' and 'to' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: An exponent is a skilled practitioner of an art, such as a noted player.

clue.text: First article on origins of baths under large former capital

parts.note: 1st written out as IST
an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: origins of means the first letters of the next two words

explanation.surface: Turkish baths beneath an old seat of empire.
explanation.definitionFit: Istanbul, once Constantinople, was the Ottoman capital before Ankara.

clue.text: Batting partners make reluctant guests!

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is said to be in
mates are partners or companions

explanation.surface: Two batsmen at the crease who are not keen to be there.
explanation.definitionFit: Prisoners are humorously guests of the state who would rather not be staying.

clue.text: Stand-in performer to check growth on crew

parts.note: to stunt is to stop something from growing
to man a ship is to crew it

explanation.surface: An understudy is told to stop the growth of the film crew.
explanation.definitionFit: A stuntman doubles for an actor in dangerous scenes.

clue.text: Bound to miss out

definitions.meaning: to leap or jump lightly along
to omit or pass over something

explanation.definitionFit: Skip means both to hop along and to leave out a part.

clue.text: The pattern of doctor's first-class cold

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor; with the possessive S
A1 is first-class, written AI
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: The typical course of a doctor's best kind of chill.
explanation.definitionFit: A mosaic is a pattern made of small pieces of tile or glass.

clue.text: Still, did coal oddly produce quartz?

indicators.note: oddly means take the odd-numbered letters from the words

explanation.surface: A question whether coal could still produce a mineral.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes the 1st, 3rd, 5th letters and so on across STILL DID COAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Silica is silicon dioxide, of which quartz is a crystalline form.

clue.text: Country gaol in uproar after article

indicators.note: after places the rearranged prison word following the article

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: uproar is chaos, so the letters of gaol are jumbled

explanation.surface: A prison riot in some nation, reported after a newspaper piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Angola is a country in southwest Africa.

clue.text: Proposal by vacant debutante brings loss of status

indicators.note: vacant means emptied of its middle, leaving the first and last letters

parts.note: a motion is a proposal put to a meeting

explanation.surface: A proposal of marriage from an empty-headed young socialite costs her standing.
explanation.definitionFit: A demotion is a drop to a lower rank or standing.

clue.text: Fantastic cash advance for each one inside

indicators.note: inside places the Latin word for each within the loan

parts.note: a sub is an advance on wages
per means for each, as in per head

explanation.surface: Getting an advance on wages for everyone would be wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: Superb means excellent, of the highest quality.

clue.text: Doctrine meaning I hand out one's millions

parts.note: to deal cards is to hand them out
one is I, so one's becomes I plus S
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: Someone explains a creed that involves giving away their fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: Idealism is a philosophical doctrine or a belief in high principles.

clue.text: Accommodation lacking in taste

definitions.meaning: a set of rooms on one floor to live in
dull or insipid, like a drink gone stale

explanation.definitionFit: Flat is both an apartment and a word for something dull or stale.

clue.text: The sort of being that might help cure an eccentric

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A creature that might lend a hand in treating an oddball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' rearranges HELP CURE AN; 'that might' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: A leprechaun is a mischievous sprite of Irish folklore, a kind of magical being.
